recommended_version.description:
We detected that you are using an outdated go2rtc server version. For the best experience, we recommend updating the go2rtc server to version `{recommended_version}`.
Currently you are using version `{current_version}`.
recommended_version.title: Outdated go2rtc server detected

unsupported_version.description:
The go2rtc server runs a version that Home Assistant does not support: {error}.
WebRTC streaming through go2rtc is unavailable until you update the go2rtc server to a supported version. Home Assistant retries automatically and removes this message when the connection succeeds.
unsupported_version.title: Unsupported go2rtc server version
